name: La Ginebrosa (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue chevron pointing to the fly bearing a green tree, continued by a blue wavy stripe to the fly, with two blue discs at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of La Ginebrosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the hoist corners and pointing to the fly
wavy stripe from the chevron to the fly
